lead: Swami Vivekananda was a monk, born on 12 January 1863 in Swami Vivekananda's Ancestral House & Cultural Centre and Kolkata.
He died on 4 July 1902 in Belur at the age of 39.
He is associated with work such as Bartaman Bharat, Raja Yoga and Jnana Yoga.
This profile collects the Swami facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Swami Vivekananda — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Swami Vivekananda was born on 12 January 1863 in Swami Vivekananda's Ancestral House & Cultural Centre and Kolkata, and holds citizenship of British Raj. He was given the name নরেন্দ্রনাথ দত্ত at birth and is publicly known as Swami Vivekananda.
Public records name his father, Vishwanath Datta. He is a sibling of Bhupendranath Dutta and Mahendranath Datta.
He received his education at Presidency University, Scottish Church College and University of Calcutta.
He is recorded as speaking English and Bangla.

sections.heading: Swami Vivekananda — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists monk, philosopher, writer, poet, teacher and spiritual leader as his occupations.
Among the credits most often linked to Swami are Bartaman Bharat, Raja Yoga, Jnana Yoga, My India: The India Eternal and dnyanyog.
He has taken part in Parliament of the World's Religions.
